modelingNotes: Unisphere — original, stylised CC0 geometry in metres, x east/y north/z up. Run: bun generators/unisphere.ts

A 36.6 m open steel globe tilted 23.5 degrees (north pole leaning north), with the Americas facing west, three orbital rings and a conical tripod base. Catalog bearing 0: the model's north is the map's north. No pool is included: this artwork replaces no OSM building extrusion.

Original procedural model from https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks (catalog id "unisphere", model "unisphere"), generated by https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks/blob/c3921f733df14b41e1f6d15853cce7b343886f17/generators/unisphere.ts. That repository is the editable source; source.blend.gz is the exported mesh imported into Blender for convenience.

Exported for Open Landmarks v1: placement bearing and scale baked in; moving parts frozen in their rest pose; footings and basements below the lowest ground (y = 0) cut away; material colours carried over exactly, as library finishes where they are not standard swatches.
